_how_to_use: Add each function below as a custom function / webhook tool in Vaani. URL = https://<your-app>.vercel.app/api/vaani/<name>?key=<WEBHOOK_SECRET>. Method POST, JSON body = the parameters.

functions.name: check_caller
functions.description: Look up the caller's phone number at the start of every call. Returns whether they are new, have enquired before, or are an existing client with a project in progress.

functions.name: get_slots
functions.description: Get up to 3 open consultation slots with a suitable designer. Call once the caller qualifies.

locality.description: Area of the property, e.g. Kothrud

functions.name: book_consult
functions.description: Book the slot the caller chose. Call only after the caller confirms a slot.

functions.name: escalate
functions.description: Existing client with a problem on a live project. Alerts Nikhil and senior staff immediately for a callback within 15 minutes.

issue.description: One or two sentences on what's wrong

post_call_webhook._note: Set Vaani's end-of-call webhook to this URL. It must include the transcript and caller number; common payload shapes are accepted.
